intro: This edition of The Builder's Brief highlights the latest advancements in AI models, agents, and research, with a focus on open-source releases, multimodal models, and inference optimization.

curated_items.title: OmniCopilot
curated_items.summary: OmniCopilot is a VS Code extension that integrates 1200+ AI models, including Kimi, Claude, GPT, and Gemini, with agent mode, tool calling, vision, and quota-aware auto-fallback. It is powered by OmniRoute and has 330+ providers, 90+ of which are free.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use OmniCopilot to access a wide range of AI models and tools, streamlining their development workflow.

curated_items.title: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model
curated_items.summary: Intern-S2-Preview is a scientific agentic foundation model that enables AI systems to reason over scientific evidence, interact with tools and environments, and sustain progress across long task horizons.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use Intern-S2-Preview to develop AI systems that can reason and interact with scientific tools and environments.

curated_items.title: DFM Mimir v1: An Open HRM Delivering Frontier Performance at 1B Parameters
curated_items.summary: DFM Mimir v1 is an open-source language model that delivers frontier performance at 1B parameters using only permissible post-training data. It is based on the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) architecture.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use DFM Mimir v1 to develop high-performance language models that are transparent and explainable.

curated_items.title: Muse Glimmer
curated_items.summary: Muse Glimmer is a brand new 30B model under a clean Apache 2.0 license. It is a significant release from Meta, marking a step up from the previous Llama licenses.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use Muse Glimmer to develop AI applications that require a high-performance, open-source language model.

curated_items.title: llama.cpp b10427 Accelerates Quantized FFNs
curated_items.summary: llama.cpp b10427 accelerates quantized FFNs, and Ollama speeds up speculative decoding for LLMs. Additionally, Meta unveiled its new local, open-source multimodal agent Muse Glimmer.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use llama.cpp and Ollama to optimize their AI models and improve performance.

curated_items.title: huggingface/transformers
curated_items.summary: The Transformers library provides a wide range of pre-trained models and a simple interface for using them. It supports text, vision, audio, and multimodal models for both inference and training.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use the Transformers library to develop AI applications that require pre-trained models and a simple interface.

curated_items.title: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design
curated_items.summary: AutoDesign is a meta-harness optimization framework for long-horizon agentic design. It enables the optimization of model-harness systems to align with human design priors and accumulate reusable experience.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use AutoDesign to develop AI systems that can optimize model-harness systems for long-horizon agentic design.

curated_items.title: DreamX-Phi 1.0: Action-Conditioned Video World Model for Robotic Manipulation
curated_items.summary: DreamX-Phi 1.0 is an action-conditioned video world model for robotic manipulation. It predicts the resulting future observations given an observed frame, a language instruction, and a prescribed action sequence.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use DreamX-Phi 1.0 to develop AI systems that can predict future observations for robotic manipulation tasks.

curated_items.title: TabSOM: A tabular-to-image encoding method based on self-organizing maps
curated_items.summary: TabSOM is a tabular-to-image encoding method based on self-organizing maps. It converts tabular data into image representations, mapping each feature at a fixed pixel location derived from a dimensionality-reduction technique.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use TabSOM to develop AI applications that require tabular-to-image encoding.

curated_items.title: GS$^{2}$CI: Robust Gaussian Splatting For Snapshot Compressive Imaging via Large Vision Model Priors
curated_items.summary: GS$^{2}$CI is a robust Gaussian splatting framework for snapshot compressive imaging. It uses large vision model priors to improve the quality of reconstructed images.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use GS$^{2}$CI to develop AI applications that require snapshot compressive imaging.
